modern: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says: Give what you will; take back what you will. And he says this not proudly, but obediently, and well pleased with her.
original: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says, Give what thou wilt; take back what thou wilt. And he says this not proudly, but obediently, and well pleased with her.
notification: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says: Give what you will; take back what you will.
notification_original: To her who gives and takes back all, to nature, the man who is instructed and modest says, Give what thou wilt; take back what thou wilt.

explained.summary: Someone who has learned well and is humble says to nature, which gives everything and takes it all back: give what you like, take back what you like. And they say it not as a show of toughness or pride, but obediently and gladly, out of real contentment with the way things work.
